name: @design-lab/workbench
description: DESIGN-LAB Workbench — the product front end. Single product Node workspace package (taskpack 24). Vanilla TypeScript + Vite; no React/Vue (taskpack 25, first stage). API response types are strict (no any); cross-language enum vocabularies are not hand-copied — taskpack 26. test:unit rebuilds build/main.js first because the tests read the committed bundle: without a build in the same script, editing shell.ts and running the tests locally reports green on the bytes that shipped before the edit (pnpm does not run pre/post hooks by default, so this cannot be a `pretest:unit` hook).

scripts.test:unit: vite build && node tests/unit.mjs && node tests/appshell.mjs && node tests/shape-notice-coverage.mjs
